args.sql: SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = '数码';

SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS profit FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(order_items.qty) AS sold_quantity FROM products JOIN order_items ON products.id = order_items.product_id WHERE products.price > 1000;
